# Awesome Jev / TypeSafe

> An independent, source-backed field guide to Jev and TypeSafe's System One models. The README is the canonical list; the JSON file is generated from its community entries. Inclusion is not endorsement.

Use the README for descriptions and caveats. Use the JSON file when you need structured category descriptions, projects, URLs, and page permalinks. Category and project pages are generated from README entries. Check linked sources before relying on a project or a reported result.

## Directory

- [Full directory in Markdown](https://abdelstark.github.io/awesome-typesafe-jev/README.md): Official resources, community projects, practical starting points, and contribution guidance.
- [Community directory in JSON](https://abdelstark.github.io/awesome-typesafe-jev/resources.json): README-derived, machine-readable community entries grouped by category.
- [Focused category pages](https://abdelstark.github.io/awesome-typesafe-jev/#community-projects): README-derived pages for each project category, each with a shareable topic card.
- [Contribution guide](https://abdelstark.github.io/awesome-typesafe-jev/CONTRIBUTING.md): Inclusion rules, evidence requirements, and correction process.

## Optional

- [Human-readable directory](https://abdelstark.github.io/awesome-typesafe-jev/): Searchable visual mirror of the README.
- [Typed-question designer](https://abdelstark.github.io/awesome-typesafe-jev/#shape-a-typed-question): Browser-only Choice, Noul, and Score SDK code generator seeded from the README's synthetic example; it makes no model request.
- [Official TypeSafe documentation](https://docs.typesafe.ai/): Current product and API documentation, maintained by TypeSafe AI.
